name: Black_Dwarf
display_fullname: Warshade Defensive Umbral Aura Black Dwarf
display_help: Kheldians are masters of energy and matter.  A Warshade can transform into a massive unstoppable essence draining beast known as a Black Dwarf.  When you choose this power, you will gain access to powerful melee and survial powers while in this form.  Additionally, 2 powers will granted to your arsenal that can be used while in other forms, Sunless Mire and Essence Drain.  While in Black Dwarf form you will only be able use your Kheldian melee powers, as well as Shadow Bolt, Ebon Eye, and specific Kheldian sustain powers.  Black Dwarf has awesome resistance to all damage except Psionics, as well as controlling effects.  Black Dwarf also has improved HP and Endurance Recovery, but is fairly limited to melee attacks.  Recharge: Fast
